extension_name.description: Extension display name shown in Safari settings and the toolbar.

extension_description.message: Fill identities and cards from your Loox vault.
extension_description.description: Extension description shown in Safari extension settings.

popup_status_locked.description: Status shown while the vault is locked.

popup_status_unlocked.description: Status shown when the vault is unlocked.

popup_locked_hint.message: Unlock to see your items for this site.

popup_unlock_button.description: Button that starts the Face ID unlock.

popup_unlocking.description: Shown while the native Face ID prompt is up.

popup_section_logins.description: Section heading for logins matching the active site.

popup_section_cards.description: Section heading for payment card items.

popup_no_matches.message: No items for this site yet.
popup_no_matches.description: Shown when the unlocked vault has nothing to list.

popup_unsupported_page.message: This page is not supported. Open a secure https site.
popup_unsupported_page.description: Shown when the active tab is not an https page.

popup_retry_button.description: Button that retries after an error.

popup_error_unreachable.message: Could not reach the app. Try again.
popup_error_unreachable.description: Shown when the native round-trip fails.

popup_copy_button.description: Copy button label on item rows.

popup_copy_username_label.description: Accessibility label for the login row copy button.

popup_copy_email_label.description: Accessibility label for the identity row copy button.

popup_copied.description: Feedback after a value was copied to the clipboard.

popup_copy_failed.description: Feedback when a copy action fails.

popup_card_ending.description: Masked card subtitle showing only the last four digits.

popup_fill_button.description: Fill button label on identity and card rows.

popup_fill_identity_label.message: Fill identity fields on this page
popup_fill_identity_label.description: Accessibility label for the identity row fill button.

popup_fill_card_label.message: Fill card fields on this page
popup_fill_card_label.description: Accessibility label for the card row fill button.

popup_filling.description: Feedback while a fill is in progress.

popup_fill_done.description: Feedback after a fill, with the number of fields filled.

popup_fill_none.message: No matching fields on this page
popup_fill_none.description: Feedback when the page has no fields the item can fill.

popup_fill_failed.description: Feedback when a fill action fails.

popup_generate_button.description: Button that fills a freshly generated strong password into the signup form's new-password fields.

save_overlay_title.description: Heading of the in-page save prompt shown after a signup is submitted.

save_overlay_title_label.description: Label of the editable item-title input in the save prompt.

save_overlay_username_label.description: Label of the editable username input in the save prompt.

save_overlay_save.description: Primary button of the save prompt: writes the new login to the vault.

save_overlay_not_now.description: Button that dismisses the save prompt without saving.

save_overlay_never.description: Button that dismisses the save prompt and stops offering it on this site.

save_overlay_saved.description: Confirmation after the new login was written to the vault.

save_overlay_duplicate.description: Shown when a login with the same site and username already exists.

save_overlay_failed.description: Shown when saving the new login fails.

inline_menu_label.description: Accessibility label of the inline suggestion menu anchored to a focused identity or card field.

inline_fill_item_label.description: Accessibility label of an inline menu row; fills the named item into the page.

inline_open_app.description: Inline menu footer row that opens the Loox app for item management.
